mapper.sql: homepage_id, consultings_idx, apply_yn, start_date, start_time, end_date, end_time, apply_start_date, apply_start_time, apply_end_date, apply_end_time, max_apply, add_id, add_date, date_type
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY WHERE homepage_id = A.homepage_id AND consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx) AS apply_count FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS A WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND consultings_idx = #{consultings_idx}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND consultings_idx = #{consultings_idx} AND apply_yn = 'Y' AND (start_date <= #{start_date} AND end_date >= #{start_date}) AND (end_date >= #{start_date} AND start_date <= #{start_date}) AND ( TO_DATE(start_date || start_time, 'yyyy-MM-ddHH24:MI') <= TO_DATE(end_date || #{end_time}, 'yyyy-MM-ddHH24:MI') AND TO_DATE(end_date || end_time, 'yyyy-MM-ddHH24:MI') >= TO_DATE(end_date || #{end_time}, 'yyyy-MM-ddHH24:MI') ) AND ( TO_DATE(end_date || end_time, 'yyyy-MM-ddHH24:MI') >= TO_DATE(start_date || #{start_time}, 'yyyy-MM-ddHH24:MI') AND TO_DATE(start_date || start_time, 'yyyy-MM-ddHH24:MI') <= TO_DATE(start_date || #{start_time}, 'yyyy-MM-ddHH24:MI') )
mapper.update: UPDATE CMS_CONSULTINGS SET apply_yn = #{apply_yn}, start_date = #{start_date}, start_time = #{start_time}, end_date = #{end_date}, end_time = #{end_time}, apply_start_date = #{apply_start_date}, apply_start_time = #{apply_start_time}, apply_end_date = #{apply_end_date}, apply_end_time = #{apply_end_time}, max_apply = #{max_apply}, date_type = #{date_type}, modify_id = #{modify_id}, modify_date = SYSDATE WHERE consultings_idx = #{consultings_idx} AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
mapper.select: SELECT MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 1, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS sun, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 2, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS mon, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 3, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS tue, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 4, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS wed, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 5, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS thu, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 6, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS fri, MIN( DECODE( TO_CHAR(days, 'D'), 7, TO_CHAR(days, 'FMDD'))) AS sat FROM ( SELECT (A.base_mon + ROWNUM -1) AS days, A.base_mon, ((TRUNC(base_mon + ROWNUM - 1, 'D') - TRUNC(TRUNC(base_mon + ROWNUM - 1, 'Y'), 'D')) / 7 + 1) AS WEEK_NUM FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE (#{plan_date}, 'yyyy-MM') base_mon FROM DUAL ) A, DICTIONARY B ) C WHERE C.days <= LAST_DAY(base_mon) GROUP BY week_num ORDER BY week_num
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CALENDAR_MANAGE WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND delete_yn = 'N' AND date_type = '1' AND start_date BETWEEN #{start_date} AND #{end_date}

SELECT TO_CHAR(start_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_date, SUM(imsi_v1) AS imsi_v1, SUM(imsi_v2) AS imsi_v2, SUM(imsi_v3) AS imsi_v3, SUM(imsi_v4) AS imsi_v4, SUM(imsi_v1+imsi_v2+imsi_v3+imsi_v4) AS imsi_v5 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT(start_date + LEVEL -1) AS start_date, imsi_v1, imsi_v2, imsi_v3, imsi_v4 FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(A.start_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_date, TO_DATE(A.end_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS end_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id AND B.apply_state = 1 ) AS imsi_v1, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id AND B.apply_state = 2 ) AS imsi_v2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id AND B.apply_state = 3 ) AS imsi_v3, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id ) AS imsi_v4 FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS A WHERE A.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ) CONNECT BY start_date + LEVEL -1 <= end_date ORDER BY start_date DESC ) WHERE start_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{start_date},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{end_date}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY ROLLUP (start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC

SELECT start_date, SUM(imsi_v1) AS imsi_v1, SUM(imsi_v2) AS imsi_v2, SUM(imsi_v3) AS imsi_v3, SUM(imsi_v4) AS imsi_v4, SUM(imsi_v1+imsi_v2+imsi_v3+imsi_v4) AS imsi_v5 FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(start_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS start_date, SUM(imsi_v1) AS imsi_v1, SUM(imsi_v2) AS imsi_v2, SUM(imsi_v3) AS imsi_v3, SUM(imsi_v4) AS imsi_v4 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT(start_date + LEVEL -1) AS start_date, imsi_v1,imsi_v2,imsi_v3,imsi_v4 FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(A.start_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_date, TO_DATE(A.end_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS end_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id AND B.apply_state = 1 ) AS imsi_v1, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id AND B.apply_state = 2 ) AS imsi_v2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id AND B.apply_state = 3 ) AS imsi_v3, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id ) AS imsi_v4 FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS A WHERE A.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ) CONNECT BY start_date + LEVEL -1 <= end_date ORDER BY start_date DESC ) WHERE TO_CHAR(start_date,'YYYY') = #{start_year} GROUP BY ROLLUP (start_date) ) GROUP BY start_date, imsi_v1, imsi_v2, imsi_v3, imsi_v4 ORDER BY start_date DESC

SELECT start_date, SUM(imsi_v1) AS imsi_v1, SUM(imsi_v2) AS imsi_v2, SUM(imsi_v3) AS imsi_v3, SUM(imsi_v4) AS imsi_v4, SUM(imsi_v1+imsi_v2+imsi_v3+imsi_v4) AS imsi_v5 FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(start_date, 'YYYY') AS start_date, SUM(imsi_v1) AS imsi_v1, SUM(imsi_v2) AS imsi_v2, SUM(imsi_v3) AS imsi_v3, SUM(imsi_v4) AS imsi_v4 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT(start_date + LEVEL -1) AS start_date, imsi_v1,imsi_v2,imsi_v3,imsi_v4 FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(A.start_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_date, TO_DATE(A.end_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS end_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id AND B.apply_state = 1 ) AS imsi_v1, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id AND B.apply_state = 2 ) AS imsi_v2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id AND B.apply_state = 3 ) AS imsi_v3, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS_APPLY B WHERE B.consultings_idx = A.consultings_idx AND B.homepage_id = A.homepage_id ) AS imsi_v4 FROM CMS_CONSULTINGS A WHERE A.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ) CONNECT BY start_date + LEVEL -1 <= end_date ORDER BY start_date DESC ) WHERE TO_CHAR(start_date,'YYYY') BETWEEN #{start_year} AND #{end_year} GROUP BY start_date ) GROUP BY ROLLUP (start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC
